name: Speak with Renferrel
summary: Speak with Renferrel is a brief errand within the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. High Executor Hadrec directs you back to the Royal Apothecary Society's local researcher to discuss findings regarding tainted wolf hearts.

sections.title: Summons from the Society
sections.body: After assisting the Deathstalkers across Silverpine Forest, High Executor Hadrec passes along an urgent message from Apothecary Renferrel. Renferrel has spent time analyzing the discolored wolf hearts gathered from the local wildlife and requires your presence immediately.

sections.title: Alchemical Curiosities
sections.body: Apothecary Renferrel serves the Royal Apothecary Society from his laboratory inside the crypt at the Sepulcher. His ongoing work explores how dark magic and disease are altering the beasts of Silverpine, bridging frontline military recon with chemical research.

faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel is located inside the Sepulcher's crypt in central Silverpine Forest, standing near his alchemy equipment just steps away from High Executor Hadrec.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Renferrel want to speak with me?
faq.answer: Renferrel has been analyzing discolored wolf hearts gathered from local Silverpine wolves and discovered peculiarities in their corruption that require further investigation and communication with the Undercity.
High Executor Hadrec, the Forsaken military commander at the Sepulcher, delivers Renferrel's summons to you once you report back from aiding his Deathstalkers.

aliases: next quest after speak with renferrel
faq.answer: Speaking with Renferrel leads directly into tasks that help connect the Sepulcher's regional alchemical research with senior figures like Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

angles.text: The Royal Apothecary Society works closely with military command at the Sepulcher, ensuring every biological anomaly in Silverpine is studied to benefit the Dark Lady's goals.
As the Horde establishes footholds across Lordaeron, understanding the corruption affecting local beasts is vital to securing the wilderness.
